status: admitted by unified H5 admission revision 7 (video_overlay_v1); proposal citrus-palette/video_tracking_overlay/video_tracking_overlay_v1_2026-10-14.md
row_rule: one row per /frames/stimulus row while the video_tracking_overlay component is declared (video logging on and the overlay enabled), every stimulus mode; the decision is made from the arena tracking view of that update before the frame is offered to the encoder; drawn and arrow_drawn record what reached the encoded frame
missing_values: typed validity, never NaN or sentinel: a field with a validity_field is meaningful only when that |u1 flag is 1, payload zero otherwise; fields without a validity field are zero when input_used is 0 (box fields) or heading_valid is 0 (heading fields)

fields.name: stimulus_frame_num
fields.meaning: session stimulus frame key; zero valid

fields.name: timestamp_ns_session
fields.meaning: Citrus session monotonic software state-output time; not photon timing

fields.name: video_frame_index
fields.meaning: index of this update's frame in the encoded session video; equals frames/stimulus video_frame_index when that is not -1

fields.name: video_frame_index_valid
fields.meaning: 1 iff the encoder accepted the frame

fields.name: decision_draw
fields.meaning: 1 iff the overlay decided to draw the dot this update

fields.name: drawn
fields.meaning: 1 iff the dot was written into the encoded frame: decision_draw and video_frame_index_valid

fields.name: input_used
fields.meaning: enum:/definitions/enums/video_overlay_input_used

fields.name: position_arena_local_px
fields.meaning: dot centre in arena-local pixels before the vertical flip: centre of the integer bounding rectangle of the four box corners projected through the camera-to-canvas homography, minus the arena origin (projected_bbox_rect_center_v1)

fields.name: position_valid
fields.meaning: explicit validity; invalid payload zero

fields.name: position_camera_px
fields.meaning: box rect centre in source camera pixels: x_min + width / 2, y_min + height / 2 in binary32; zero when input_used is 0

fields.name: source_camera_id
fields.meaning: SHAMAN v2 numeric camera id of the slot that supplied the box

fields.name: source_camera_id_valid
fields.meaning: explicit validity; invalid payload zero

fields.name: box_sequence_id
fields.meaning: SHAMAN v2 slot sequence that supplied the box (a held box keeps its own)

fields.name: box_sequence_id_valid
fields.meaning: explicit validity; invalid payload zero

fields.name: box_recording_frame_id
fields.meaning: Orange recording_frame_id (frame identity v1) of the box slot; valid only inside a bound recording

fields.name: box_recording_frame_id_valid
fields.meaning: explicit validity; invalid payload zero

fields.name: box_index_in_payload
fields.meaning: the box's object index within its payload; zero when input_used is 0

fields.name: box_payload_timestamp_ns_monotonic
fields.meaning: Orange steady-clock publish time of the payload that supplied the box (bounding_boxes payload_timestamp_ns_monotonic), kept through a hold; zero when input_used is 0

fields.name: heading_status
fields.meaning: enum:/definitions/enums/phototaxis_heading_status

fields.name: heading_camera_angle_degrees
fields.meaning: current pose heading, atan2_negative_y_x_degrees in source camera pixels (y down); same dtype and value as the pose object row

fields.name: heading_origin_camera_px
fields.meaning: current pose heading origin in source camera pixels, x then y; same value as the pose object row

fields.name: heading_valid
fields.meaning: 1 iff heading_status == 7

fields.name: arrow_origin_arena_local_px
fields.meaning: arrow origin: the pose heading origin projected through the camera-to-canvas homography (no bounding rectangle) minus the arena origin

fields.name: arrow_direction_canvas
fields.meaning: unit arrow direction in canvas (x right, y down) by the two-probe canvas midline rule (two_probe_canvas_midline_v1)

fields.name: midline_valid
fields.meaning: 1 iff a canvas midline was produced; implies heading_valid

fields.name: arrow_drawn
fields.meaning: 1 iff the arrow was written into the encoded frame: drawn and midline_valid and settings heading_arrow.active

fields.name: pose_sequence_id
fields.meaning: SHAMAN v2 slot sequence of the current pose, the slot the heading came from

fields.name: pose_sequence_id_valid
fields.meaning: explicit validity; invalid payload zero

fields.name: pose_recording_frame_id
fields.meaning: Orange recording_frame_id of the pose slot; valid only inside a bound recording

fields.name: pose_recording_frame_id_valid
fields.meaning: explicit validity; invalid payload zero

fields.name: pose_object_index_in_payload
fields.meaning: the pose object's index within its payload, equal to box_index_in_payload by construction; zero without a current pose

arithmetic.position_camera_px: (x_min + width / 2.0f, y_min + height / 2.0f) in binary32 from the bounding_boxes v2 row fields
arithmetic.position_arena_local_px: the four box corners (x_min, y_min), (x_min + width, y_min), (x_min + width, y_min + height), (x_min, y_min + height) projected per corner in double through /calibration_snapshot/<camera_serial>/homography_matrix (CV_64F): w = h20*x + h21*y + h22; |w| <= 1e-12 => no position (position_valid 0); x' = (h00*x + h01*y + h02) / w, y' = (h10*x + h11*y + h12) / w (true division); each cast to float; cv::boundingRect of the four float points (OpenCV 4.10.0: xmin = floor(min x), xmax = floor(max x), width = xmax - xmin + 1, same for y); the integer rectangle converted to float, shifted by minus the integer arena_geometry origin_px, centre = rect.x + rect.width / 2.0f, rect.y + rect.height / 2.0f in binary32; checked exactly
arithmetic.arrow_origin_arena_local_px: the pose heading origin projected exactly as one corner (double, true division, |w| <= 1e-12 => no midline, float cast), no bounding rectangle, minus the integer origin_px in float
arithmetic.arrow_direction_canvas: probes in binary32 camera px: forward = origin + 20.0f * d, left = origin + 20.0f * left_axis (d = the pose row unit direction, left_axis = (d.y, -d.x)), multiply then add, contraction off; each projected as the origin; dx, dy = forward' - origin' in binary32; len = sqrt(double(dx)^2 + double(dy)^2); len <= 1e-6 or any failed projection (left probe included) => midline_valid 0; else (float(double(dx)/len), float(double(dy)/len)); no hypot; unit length within 1e-6

invariants: video_frame_index_valid equals the /frames/stimulus row's video_frame_index_valid for the same stimulus_frame_num, and when 1 the two video_frame_index values are equal
decision_draw == 1 implies position_valid == 1 and input_used in {1, 2}; input_used == 2 and settings held_policy == skip implies decision_draw == 0
input_used == 0 implies position_valid 0, the three box identities invalid and payload zero (position_camera_px, box_index_in_payload, box_payload_timestamp_ns_monotonic included)
input_used >= 1 implies source_camera_id_valid, box_sequence_id_valid and box_recording_frame_id_valid; source_camera_id equals binding_json shaman_numeric_camera_id

bounding-box cross-check, every row with input_used >= 1: a /observations/bounding_boxes v2 row must exist with payload_camera_id == source_camera_id, recording_frame_id == box_recording_frame_id and box_index_in_payload equal (absent => refuse); same payload_timestamp_ns_monotonic => position_camera_px equals that row's rect centre exactly; a later bbox timestamp => the overlay used an update the per-frame filter later replaced (accepted, centre not compared); an earlier bbox timestamp => refuse
box_sequence_id non-decreasing over valid rows; pose_sequence_id non-decreasing over valid rows; stimulus_frame_num strictly increasing
heading_valid == 1 iff heading_status == 7; midline_valid == 1 implies heading_valid == 1; heading fields payload zero when heading_valid 0, midline fields payload zero when midline_valid 0

heading_valid == 1 implies the /observations/pose update pose_sequence_id has camera_id == source_camera_id and its object pose_object_index_in_payload is status 7 with heading_angle_degrees and heading_origin_{x,y}_px bit-equal to heading_camera_angle_degrees and heading_origin_camera_px; pose_object_index_in_payload == box_index_in_payload
input_used == 2 (held box) implies heading_status 0 (the arrow never uses a held heading)
arrow_drawn == 1 iff drawn == 1 and midline_valid == 1 and settings heading_arrow.active
pose observation disabled for the session implies heading_status 0 on every row and settings heading_arrow.active false; active implies pose observation v3 present

settings: enabled true whenever the component exists; radius_px == radius_mm * pixels_per_mm_projector and heading_arrow.length_px == length_mm * pixels_per_mm_projector (the calibration snapshot camera attribute pixels_per_mm_projector); color_quantised_rgba == rgba8_round_half_up_v1(color_authored_rgba) for the dot and the arrow; thickness_px integer >= 1; held_policy in {draw, skip}
witness_notes: fixtures/video_overlay_v1/: three complete files: identity homography (exact-integer corners, the floor-boundary case; no encoder, drawn 0), the rig homography with a y reflection and perspective terms (general projective arithmetic; encoder acceptance simulated, drawn and arrow_drawn 1 on true values), and a constructed homography whose w = 0 line passes through the heading's left probe (heading_valid 1, midline_valid 0, drawn 1, arrow_drawn 0). check_overlay_arith.py beside this file is Citrus's independent Python replication of the arithmetic; it reports zero differences on all three.
